title: Reliance Q2 Net Profit Jumps 16% to Rs 19,324 Crore, Beats Street Estimates
description: Reliance Industries reported consolidated net profit rising 16% year-on-year to Rs 19,324 crore, driven by robust retail EBITDA and telecom subscriber additions.

title: Reliance Industries Q2 Profit Surges Driven by Retail and Jio Growth
description: RIL posts stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings as retail and Jio segments show double-digit expansion amid operational efficiency.

title: RIL Q2 Earnings Exceed Analyst Forecasts on Record Margin Gains
description: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani-led conglomerate Reliance Industries topped analyst estimates for quarterly profit, supported by oil-to-chemical recovery and retail expansion.

title: Reliance Jio Unveils 5G-Enabled Cloud AI Device Platform
description: Jio Platforms announced the commercial launch of its indigenous enterprise cloud and generative AI service platform for Indian businesses.

title: SEBI Issues Show-Cause Notice to Reliance Entity Over Related Party Transactions
description: Markets regulator SEBI has issued an inquiry notice examining compliance around related-party contract disclosures by a subsidiary of Reliance Industries.
